tagline: Record profits, deepest layoffs, drones on the export route.

kpis.l: barrels of oil equivalent produced daily
Hess acquisition closed after Exxon arbitration win

lead_thesis: Chevron's record quarter rests on war-driven oil prices, yet every Kazakh barrel still exits through one exposed artery: Tengiz to the Black Sea. The fix is redundancy in power, routes and people, not deeper cuts that hollow out the operators keeping barrels moving.
lead_support: CPC (Caspian Pipeline Consortium) is the pipeline system that carries Kazakh crude to a Black Sea terminal. When drones hit tankers there, Tengiz, Chevron's 50%-owned supergiant field, cannot sell what it pumps.
